changes: Root package.json scripts only: chained 8 fast contract-guards/wrapper-root smokes into the root test script (the gate path lattice validate + the REVIEW->TEST gate both run via npm-test fallback) — test:process-fact-contract, test:runtime-fact-contract, test:evidence-quality (new root alias -> scripts/verify-evidence-quality.mjs), test:anti-stall, test:storydir-inside-gitroot-smoke, test:gitroot-cwd-routing, test:bare-gate-gitroot-cwd, test:done-oracle-wrapper-root. Added 5 aliases (test:evidence-quality + delegating aliases for done-oracle-wrapper-root, storydir-inside-gitroot-smoke, storydir-inside-gitroot-suite, plus test:smokes-full). gitroot-cwd-contract was already chained so it is NOT duplicated. No guard/smoke assertion logic, gitRoot code, or process-fact-registry touched.
usage: Run `lattice validate` (or advance any story REVIEW->TEST): the root npm test chain now executes the 8 newly-gated guards; a RED guard fails npm test -> validate reports status=fail -> the gate blocks. The slow storydir suite + full 160-smoke sweep are reachable via `npm run test:smokes-full` (full/CI path), kept OUT of the fast gate.
expectedOutcome: lattice validate prints the 8 newly-gated guard steps and exits PASS; deliberately breaking one wired guard makes lattice validate report status=fail (failing step named), and reverting restores status=pass.
actualTranscript: lattice validate --story=B-99b6 -> status=pass allPass=true, all 8 guards listed and grep-FOUND, verification coverage total:8/covered:8/missingRequired:0. Break test:anti-stall (&& exit 1) -> validate --json status=fail allPass=false summary: Project validation commands failed; ✗ package.json test script: npm test. git restore -> status=pass allPass=true commands[].code=0. test:process-fact-contract (the incident guard) is now IN the gate battery.
outcomeDiff: No difference — expected and actual match exactly: GREEN with the guards listed, RED on a broken guard (named, no silent skip), GREEN after revert.
limitations: The 17 FAIL + 6 TIMEOUT smokes in the full test:all suite are PRE-EXISTING baseline failures on clean main (139/162 at main HEAD e656ad861), independent of this scripts-only edit (a scripts edit cannot alter smoke assertions); they live in test:all behind test:smokes-full, correctly out of the fast gate. They warrant a separate infra story (the full-suite stabilization), out of B-99b6 scope. Otherwise none — fully covered.
pitfalls: (1) scope_freeze_check FAILED under mode=correctness_fix because the future-capability keyword Authority appears in the story text (context-only mention of authority-gate smokes) — switched to mode=maintenance (the correct fit for battery wiring) and it passed. (2) Post-merge, story-scoped validate showed status=fail with covered:0 — this is evidence-freshness (headHash changed by the merge), NOT a battery failure; the un-scoped validate stayed status=pass. Fix: re-record verification_evidence_add after the merge to refresh headHash, then re-validate green. Next person: keep guards GREEN before wiring — never exclude a guard to pass; the whole point is RED becomes visible.
